_comment: Published SROIE Task-3 (KIE) leaderboard / paper numbers — global token-level F1 on the canonical 347-image test set. Used by the ADVANCED paper variant (template_advanced.tex → Table tab:competitors). Edit this file when adding or updating competitor numbers; the table is regenerated by report.inject_competitors during stage_paper. Each entry MUST cite a source (a paper, leaderboard URL, or 'this work' for our own numbers). The two rows whose 'system' starts with 'this work' are sourced from combined_metrics.json at runtime — leave their 'f1' field as null.

_schema.params_m: parameter count in millions; null if unknown
_schema.f1: global token-F1 on Task-3 test set; null = sourced from combined_metrics at runtime
_schema.source: citation key (must exist in references.bib) or 'this work'

competitors.notes: original DONUT paper, fine-tuned on SROIE
Task-3 reported in the LayoutLMv2 paper
